text.p: Typhoon Fern is a moderate risk to shipping west of Guam at this time. It should track towards the northern Mariana islands this period. Rough seas and squalls along its path will continue to impact shipping through the period. The northern Mariana islands may see heavy rains and flooding later in this period.

Tropical cyclone Fergus will be a significant risk to shipping as it tracks from just southeast of the Solomon islands to just west of the Vanuatu islands during the next 48 hours. No major islands are directly affected but several may see gusty winds and heavy rain.
Tropical depression Greg is only a minor risk to shipping east of Sabah Malaysia this period. It is expected to weaken even further during this period.

Tropical cyclone 12p is no longer a significant risk to shipping in the Gulf of Carpentaria as it has made landfall over the North Territory. It is moving further inland at this time. It may lead to some locally flooding in this area during this time.
